title: 10-Year Budget Projections
description: CBO's baseline projections of spending and revenues by category and of deficits and debt held by the public, for a 10-year horizon.

notes.units: Levels are in billions_of_dollars. GDP-share variables are percentage of GDP.
notes.first_year_actual: The first year in each vintage is actual (realized); subsequent years are CBO projections.
